name: openclank
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Open Clank instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Open Clank tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Open Clank through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Open Clank Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Open Clank only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
